initial_definitions.AC-001: The contract preserves the ten manual sections, unit/schema/diagnostic/result-envelope evidence slots, public/private and protected-content boundaries, visible gaps and limitations, software-release versus project-reliance distinction, and human-owned professional judgment without certification or code-compliance claims.
initial_definitions.OUT-001: A validation-manual skeleton contract separating mechanics verification, intended-use workflow validation, user rule checks, and professional reliance across the required manual outline is produced.
initial_definitions.VER-001: Validate the contract and review source parity, ten-section outline coverage, separation of verification/validation/rule checks/professional reliance, data and provenance boundaries, unit and diagnostic evidence slots, visible TBDs, and release/professional-authority limits.

professional_reliance: PASS — existing professional-reliance, approval, compliance, protected-content, private-data, and authority limits remain literal and no new reliance claim is introduced.
source_grounding: PASS — definitions conservatively name the deliverable, preserved constraints, and verification of exact source parity; they do not add an engineering outcome.
